target_customer: Music labels, studios and creators who want AI-generated video from audio or scripts
problem: Producing music videos and short films is slow and costly, and AI video raises likeness-consent issues.
business_model: Paid pilots with entertainment companies plus a public beta

founders.name: Mehul Agarwal
education: Carnegie Mellon University, CS and ML
founders.background_notes: YC page: part-time standup comedian; sibling of co-founder.

founders.name: Gauri Agarwal
education: Carnegie Mellon School of Computer Science, class of 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Audio-to-video storytelling with consistent likeness and a patented consent protocol builds on the founders' NeurIPS research.

defensibility.rationale: Patented consent protocol and label pilots help, but foundation video model vendors move fast.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No action against Koyal found as of 2026-11; another YC AI filmmaking startup, Flick, announced a $6M seed in May 2026.

market_need_then: Paid pilots with Universal Music, T-Series and others are company-reported on the YC page; unverified independently.

branding.name_origin: A Daily Pioneer profile says the name comes from the koyal (cuckoo) bird known for its melodious voice, fitting the audio-first product.

identity.mascot_or_character: Koyal bird as namesake; no mascot found

branding.community_and_virality: Launched #4 Product of the Day in Nov 2025 per one review site; press release on Waves 2025

brand_strength.rationale: Name suits an audio product and has local cultural resonance; evidence of brand pull is limited.

outcome_analysis: Koyal is a Fall 2025 brother-sister company building agentic AI filmmaking with research roots at CMU and MIT. It reports paid pilots with music companies and a public beta, but no verified funding beyond YC, exit or shutdown as of 2026-11. Strengths are research depth and entertainment access; risk is fast-moving video model providers and unproven revenue.
notes: Neuronfeed and CB Insights show $500K total (CB Insights lists a seed on 2025-10-22 with Pioneer Fund and YC); aggregator only, not recorded. Company website fetch returned only a title. No dated competitor list near the batch; sources were 2026 roundups.
